products.title: Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH LED Monitor
products.description: The Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH is a 27-inch 4K UHD LED monitor designed for detailed visuals and multitasking. It features a 3840 x 2160 resolution IPS panel with 350 cd/m² brightness, a 1000:1 static contrast ratio, and HDR10 support for enhanced color and contrast. The monitor includes versatile connectivity with USB-C (providing 90W charging and data transfer), LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort. It is equipped with a built-in KVM switch and supports Picture-in-Picture/Picture-by-Picture. For user comfort, it features an ergonomic stand supporting tilt, swivel, and height adjustment, along with Eye Saver Mode and Flicker Free technology.

key_features: Eye Saver Mode and Flicker Free technology

products.title: Samsung 27" ViewFinity S8 (S80UD) 4K UHD Monitor
products.description: The Samsung ViewFinity S80UD is a 27-inch 4K HDR monitor designed for productivity and versatility. It features a 16:9 IPS panel with a UHD resolution of 3840 x 2160, supporting HDR10 for lifelike images and a wide color gamut of 99% sRGB. The monitor is equipped with comprehensive connectivity, including HDMI, DisplayPort, and a USB-C port that provides up to 90W of power delivery for laptops. A built-in KVM switch allows users to control two devices with a single keyboard and mouse. The ergonomic design includes a fully adjustable stand (height, tilt, swivel, and rotation) and is TÜV-certified for eye care to reduce flicker and blue light.

products.title: ViewFinity S8 (S80UD) 37" 4K UHD LED Monitor
products.description: Experience crystal-clear visual excellence with the Samsung 37" ViewFinity S8 Monitor. Featuring 4K UHD resolution for enhanced detail and a larger screen space, this monitor is ideal for professionals working on intricate designs, complex diagrams, or dynamic video content. With 1.07 billion colors and HDR10 support, enjoy a vast spectrum of hues, true-to-life color representation, and deeper contrast for stunning blacks and brights. The versatile USB-C port allows for up to 90W charging and simultaneous data transfer, while the built-in LAN port provides seamless Ethernet connectivity for laptops. Multitask efficiently with the built-in KVM switch, enabling split screen, Picture-in-Picture, or Picture-by-Picture modes. The ergonomic design includes a height-adjustable screen that tilts and swivels for optimal viewing comfort at any angle. Setup is simple with the Easy Setup Stand, requiring no tools. This monitor is TÜV-certified for intelligent eye care, reducing screen flickering and protecting against excessive blue light, with automatic brightness and color temperature optimization based on your environment. Constructed with at least 14% recycled plastic, this thoughtfully designed monitor reflects Samsung's commitment to sustainability.
